mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever rates are at or below 0.1%.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.1%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 0.1), or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 0.1 is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 420,000 (in thousands) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 900 AND RSAFS < 420000, or the interaction effect (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) reflects a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 7.0% is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply chain activity and manufacturing output, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC for INDPRO > 100 is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 900) signal a weakening housing market, which is a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 900, or the Rank IC for HOUST < 900 is below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) indicates rising price pressures, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 230 is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak employment growth (PAYEMS < 136000) indicates a slowing labor market, reducing consumer income and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 136000, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS < 136000 is below 0.02 over any 1-year window.
